fields.name: Sunscreen SPF 50+ Invisible Shield
fields.description: Ultra-lightweight, non-greasy broad spectrum SPF 50 sun protection infused with Hyaluronic Acid and Niacinamide. Leaves zero white cast and provides a radiant, hydrated finish.
fields.ingredients: Water, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Hyaluronic Acid, Titanium Dioxide, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Centella Asiatica Extract.
fields.how_to_use: Apply generously 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2 hours or after swimming and sweating.

fields.name: Gentle Hydrating Face Wash
fields.description: Sulfate-free foaming gel cleanser enriched with Chamomile and Green Tea. Gently dissolves impurities and makeup without stripping natural skin moisture.
fields.ingredients: Aqua, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Chamomilla Recutita Flower Extract, Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Leaf Extract, Panthenol, Glycerin.
fields.how_to_use: Pump a small amount onto damp hands. Gently massage onto face in circular motions for 60 seconds. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

fields.name: Vitamin C Glow Elixir Serum
fields.description: Stabilized 15% L-Ascorbic Acid Serum powered by Ferulic Acid and Vitamin E. Target hyperpigmentation, boost collagen production, and reveal luminous skin tone.
fields.ingredients: Water, Ascorbic Acid, Ferulic Acid, Tocopherol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Propanediol, Phenoxyethanol.
fields.how_to_use: Apply 3-4 drops in the morning on clean skin before moisturizer and SPF.

fields.name: Niacinamide 10% Clarifying Serum
fields.description: High-strength 10% Niacinamide with 1% Zinc PCA. Minimizes enlarged pores, regulates sebum production, and smooths skin texture.
fields.ingredients: Aqua, Niacinamide, Zinc PCA, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Ethoxydiglycol, Xanthan Gum.
fields.how_to_use: Apply 2-3 drops morning and evening to entire face after cleansing.

fields.name: Oversized Heavyweight Cotton Hoodie
fields.description: Premium 450 GSM organic French Terry fleece hoodie. Designed with a boxy relaxed drop-shoulder silhouette, double-lined hood, and deep kangaroo pocket.
fields.how_to_use: Machine wash cold inside out with like colors. Tumble dry low or hang dry.

fields.name: Relaxed Linen Blend Button-Down Shirt
fields.description: Breathable 55% Linen 45% Cotton blend shirt designed for warm weather sophistication. Features a casual camp collar and mother-of-pearl buttons.
fields.how_to_use: Machine wash cool. Iron on medium heat while slightly damp for best crispness.

fields.name: Tailored High-Waisted Wide Leg Trousers
fields.description: Elegantly draped wide-leg trousers featuring front pleats, slant pockets, and a clean tailored waistband.
fields.how_to_use: Dry clean recommended or gentle hand wash.

fields.name: Apex Runner Pro Performance Sneakers
fields.description: Engineered for high-mileage road running with responsive NitroFoam cushioning and breathable FlyKnit upper. Superior energy return with durable grip outsole.
fields.ingredients: FlyKnit Textile Upper, Nitrogen-infused EVA Foam Midsole, Rubber Outsole.
fields.how_to_use: Spot clean with damp cloth and mild sneaker cleaner. Air dry.

fields.name: Urban Retro Leather Low-Top Sneakers
fields.description: Classic vintage court silhouette crafted from full-grain Italian leather with cushioned orthotic insoles and durable vulcanized rubber soles.
fields.ingredients: Full-grain Leather, Cotton Laces, Rubber Sole
fields.how_to_use: Apply leather conditioner monthly. Protect with water-repellent spray.
